description: This file defines data classes for weather data modeling, including daily forecasts, current weather, and a combined weather response. It also includes a sealed class for handling success and error results.

classes.name: DataResult
classes.description: Sealed class representing success or error state with generic success data or an error throwable.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Data class representing successful data retrieval, encapsulating data of generic type T.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Data class representing an error with an associated throwable.
